subject: ACE enrollment + PDM/PSM intro: Orbitrek cloud marketplace sync
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Young <samantha.young@orbitrek.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACE enrollment + PDM/PSM intro: Orbitrek cloud marketplace sync

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet you on the call last week. Orbitrek looks like a strong fit for an AWS co-sell pathway and we should get ACE enrollment and the PDM/PSM intros started so we don’t lose momentum. Proposed immediate items: 

- Kick off ACE registration (we can own submission but need confirmation of the point of contact)
- Intro to Orbitrek PDM / PSM so AWS can pair us for opportunity coverage
- Align on the opportunity scope and who will own listing assets (one-pager, logo, SOW)

I attached our ACE_onboarding_checklist.xlsx to make the next steps explicit. Can you confirm the Orbitrek contacts (procurement and technical PSM/PDM) and any timing constraints for the listing? Also, are there any contracting steps (MSA/PO) we should route early to avoid procurement delays?

Suggested next step: a 30-min sync this week to run through the ACE form, owner assignments, and the HubSpot opportunity details. I’m free Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: ACE_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Samantha Young <samantha.young@orbitrek.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kyle Park <kyle.park@orbitrek.com>, Orbitrek Procurement <procurement@orbitrek.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 10:13:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ACE enrollment + PDM/PSM intro: Orbitrek cloud marketplace sync

Aditya —

Thanks for the checklist, looks good. For Orbitrek the primary contacts are: 
- Kyle Park (Cloud GTM lead / PDM) — kyle.park@orbitrek.com
- Procurement inbox — procurement@orbitrek.com (will loop in the buyer as needed)

We can do Tue 20 3:30pm PT / Wed 21 11:00am ET — both work for Kyle and me. We have a one-pager for the partnership (attached) and a draft SOW we can share. Procurement will want to see pricing bands and a short summary for the internal security review.

Two asks from our side: 
1) If Redwood can lead the ACE registration form submission, let us know the owner and what orbital assets you need (logos, one-pager link, contact emails).
2) Can you confirm what PSM scope looks like on Redwood side during co-sell engagements — will the PSM be primarily enablement or also involved in deployment triage?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re aiming to have ACE registration submitted by EOD next week so we can get on AWS radar for the upcoming Q3 co-sell planning.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Orbitrek
Samantha.young@orbitrek.com

Attachment: Orbitrek_GTM_onepager.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: ACE enrollment + PDM/PSM intro: Orbitrek cloud marketplace sync

Forwarding Orbitrek reply — planning note and asks below.

> Aditya —
> 
> Thanks for the checklist, looks good. For Orbitrek the primary contacts are:

>

Notes / asks for Redwood team: 
- Marissa: can you take ACE registration as owner? We’ll need the following assets from you: Redwood logo (PNG + SVG), short 200-300 word product blurb, and a contact email for the listing. Ideally would submit the ACE intake form by next Friday (2025-05-30).
- Laura: please confirm whether we should route this through the AWS Marketplace team or the ACE registration intake (they overlap but have slightly different asset requirements). If we need to include a pricing SKU, let me know who on pricing should be cc’d.
- Ben: FYI — Orbitrek is a mid-market SaaS with expected pilot spend in Q3; start prepping the pricing template and standard SOW clauses (I’ve attached the existing SOW we discussed).

I’ll tentatively book Wed 21 11:00am ET for the intro unless you tell me otherwise.

Thanks —
Aditya

Attachment (forwarded): Orbitrek_GTM_onepager.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ACE enrollment + PDM/PSM intro: Orbitrek cloud marketplace sync

Thanks Aditya — I’ll own the ACE registration end-to-end. Plan below: 

1) ACE intake submission owner: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com)
2) Assets I need from product & marketing: Redwood logo (SVG + PNG), 250-word product blurb, short customer value bullets, and a sample pricing tier. Aditya — can you drop the blurb in Slack and share the HubSpot deal link?
3) Internal routing: Laura, please confirm whether we should request the AWS Marketplace listing or register only for ACE. If Marketplace listing is required, timeline extends ~2 weeks for asset approvals.
4) Compliance/Procurement: I’ll send Orbitrek a short checklist to procurement (procurement@orbitrek.com) and loop in legal for the MSA. We’ll aim to have the MSA in DocuSign next week.

Action items: 
- Marissa: submit ACE form by 2025-05-30 (owner)
- Aditya: confirm HubSpot deal and push product blurb (today)
- Ben: draft SOW changes and pricing template (EOD Monday)
- Laura: confirm Marketplace vs ACE path (EOD today)

I’ve attached orbitrek_sow_v1.pdf and a draft redwood_msa_v3.docx for legal to look at.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
